name: birdtier

scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('dist-single/app.html','dist-single/index.html')" && node tools/classic-script.mjs dist-single/index.html
scripts.build:pages: vite build --mode pages && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('docs/app.html','docs/index.html')" && node tools/classic-script.mjs docs/index.html && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll', '')"

description: Birdtier — Beyond the Solar System: a browser space exploration simulator starring a crew of bird astronauts (Three.js + React + Vite).
